# Sobhan Nami
> Personal portfolio, technology leadership profile, and pro bono engineering advisory hub of Sobhan Nami, Co-founder & CTO at Ronika and Software Architect for ThingsPod and Dahir.

Sobhan Nami is an Iranian software engineer, system architect, and technology leader with a Top Rank M.Sc. in Secure Computing from Shiraz University. He focuses on distributed backend architectures, industrial IoT platforms, and providing free, pro bono mentorship and technical advisory for businesses, students, and tech startups.

## Pages
- [Persian Portfolio (صفحه فارسی)](https://sobhannami.ir/fa/): Main Persian single-page portfolio, advisory scope, and direct communication channels.
- [English Portfolio](https://sobhannami.ir/en/): English single-page portfolio, advisory pillars, and direct communication channels.

## Architected Platforms
- [ThingsPod](https://thingspod.io): High-throughput industrial IoT telemetry, edge data computing, and device fleet management.
- [Dahir](https://dahir.io): Smart marine aquaculture automation platform utilizing acoustic feeding controllers and telemetry.
- [Ronika](https://ronikapars.com): Knowledge-based company developing smart utility meters, industrial IoT, and connected devices.
